name: Hexicon AB (publ)
summary: Hexicon AB (publ) specializes in the design, manufacturing, sales, and operation of offshore wave and wind energy systems. The company is particularly known for developing, constructing, and managing floating offshore wind farms. It innovates with unique dual-turbine floating power platforms, which support two wind turbines that pivot around a single mooring point. Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, Hexicon conducts its primary operations across several international regions, including South Korea, Scotland, Spain, Sweden, South Africa, and Ireland.
